random_normal_model.probability_sampling: sample 256 retained accepted sigmoid probabilities independently with replacement
random_normal_model.selection: stable score-descending top-8 with lower expert ID winning exact ties
random_normal_model.independent_bound: retained per-expert v1 absolute score-error bounds summed for every selected/unselected pair

arbitrary_route_pairwise_antecedent_poli.optimistic_scenario: multiply every independent bound by the minimum observed retained ratio
arbitrary_route_pairwise_antecedent_poli.interpretation: central and optimistic scenarios are planning sensitivities, never real qualification bounds

planning_decision.threshold_basis: retain the pre-existing 0.90 planning standard before spending the naive 96-payload eight-fixture budget; decoded-tensor reuse needs separate review

correlated_family_surrogate_if_required.model: fixed 16-factor expert-logit loading matrix calibrated only to retained logit mean/std plus fixed retained bias
